matched_condition: After C1, the assistant revises the disk-cache direction, discusses nonpersistent alternatives, or asks about recomputation, reuse within a run, or acceptable delay.
message: Each invocation needs just one report, and 20 seconds is tolerable for now. I choose to drop cross-run caching and investigate where computation time goes before deciding on optimization. We do not know yet whether that investigation will find a useful improvement. Please recap.
